name: dire_maul_west
notes: DRAFT, census 2026-10-24 (no live run): the world export of map 429 (tools/dungeongen/testdata/map429), the world SQL (~/tortoise-wow/sql/base) and the instance script (src/scripts/dungeons/dire_maul). Every hostile trash spawn of the west wing is a pull member (217 units, 83 pulls) except the 18 Residual Monstrosities 11484 (not pulled: see the ring note); the 6 bosses are boss steps. Not mapped: the GM-invisible mapping walk is still to do (after the round-2 chains: 3 detour pulls and 98 run-leader hop notices remain) (dungeon_run refuses the plan without allow_draft).

Neutral NPCs left out (29 Shen'dralar Wisps 14361, level 1, faction 1354; 16 Highborne Summoners 11466, faction 1355): faction_template hostileMask 0, so neither is trash and the run leader would find no pack. The 6 Gordok mobs at 273-304 183-325 (north-wing courtyard, faction 45) are not this wing's; the north plan has them.

Crystal (pylon) event (instance_dire_maul::SetData TYPE_CRISTAL_EVENT): five CrystalGenerator gameobjects - 177259 16.8 277.2 -8.5, 177257 111.9 436.1 28.6, 177258 -85.2 444.7 28.6, 179504 71.1 874.5 -24.6, 179505 -130.4 713.0 -24.6 - each holding four Mana Remnants (11483) within 20 yd. Each crystal has one four-guard pull from a stand 15-25 yd off the pack and a hold on the crystal's object state (active): the hold fights any remnant the pull left and ends only when the crystal is used, so a missed guardian pauses at the crystal instead of at Immol'thar. Killing the last four opens the force field 179503 and the magic vortex 179506 (-38.6 812.7 -29.5) and makes Immol'thar selectable. No use_object step: the kills do it.

Immol'thar's 16 Highborne Summoners turn hostile (faction 100) at the crystal event and attack him; before that they are neutral. Tortheldrin is enabled only when Immol'thar dies (TYPE_IMMOL_THAR DONE), so his leg is the last.

Ferra (14308) is Illyanna's pet and stands 3 yd from her: her boss step lists Ferra first. Revanchion (14690) is Turtle's (loot 14690, 26862 hp via database_updates/world/20260510092659 over the base 24420, Frost Nova 29849): his leg is first in the hall so the hall's trash never wakes him. Tsu'zee (11467, rank 2 rare) is a member of the 3.5 pull (11467,11471, radius 8.6); no skip list (the run leader's rows carry none and would pull him anyway). kill_first holds the four casters, not him.

Fleers: none. No trash entry has the EventAI flee (action 47); the Spectres, the Summoners and the Mana Remnants stand and die. CC: nothing but the Darter (14398, dragonkin) and the Summoners is not undead/elemental, and Polymorph takes neither, so cc_priority and cc_always are empty; no_cc lists every trash entry. kill_first: the two healers/regrowthers (14303 Petrified Guardian, 11473 Eldreth Spectre), the Sorcerer 11470 (Polymorph 13323, Chain Lightning) and the summoner 11484 (Mana Bursts).

Patrols: 50 pull groups carry a patrol block with an estimated period (path length at 2.5 yd/s): the 17 Eldreth Spectres (329-748 yd loops), the 8 Ironbark Protectors (610-689 yd), the 5 Arcane Torrents (496-630 yd) and Illyanna (266 yd); the 18 Residual Monstrosities (705 yd) no longer carry a pull at all. The blocks are for the agent's driver; the run leader's rows carry no patrol.

Doors: the west-wing door 300601 at 50.6 501.4 -23.3 (lock 1562; the lock table is not in this world export - the Crescent Key 18249 is the inference from the other Dire Maul doors, so give the commander the key) and the stair door 177211 at 106.1 623.7 -26.3 (no lock). Both are state 1/active; the plan has no door step.

Three detour pulls remain for the mapping walk (leg 0 group 27, leg 3 groups 3 and 8): the pack lies on its own floor but the way from the previous row is on another. Leg 2 group 3's pit climb is an approach chain now (round 2). No pull member stands on another floor than its row (|dz| <= 6). The dreadsteed ritual (Bell 179674, Candle 179673, Wheel 179672, circle 179668 at 800-825 812.7) is a class quest, not part of the clear. The crumble wall 177220 is the east wing's door, not this one.

Server-path fix 2026-10-24 round 2 (r33 slot7b step 112): the 50 yd split of the exporter's 22.4 379.2 -3.5 -> 21.33 448 -20.5 drop to the Tendris boss landed at 21.6 427.7 -15.5, which is in mid air (path-check: not on the navmesh, the live step 112 skipped it); the boss now carries the on-mesh approach points 21.6 420 -4.4 and 21.33 448 -20.5.

Residual Monstrosities (11484, 18 of them) are not pulled: they guard nothing (the crystals are guarded by the 20 Mana Remnants 11483, the boss only needs the crystal event), all 18 walk the same 18-point 705 yd waypoint ring (creature_movement guids 352901-352915, 341529, 353467-353491), so no stand on that walkway is outside a patrol path, and a fixed pull of a patrolling unit either finds nothing or meets the next patrol. Live r36 steps 421/425: the patrols joining the first ring fights wiped the party 5 times. The ring's trash is left to normal aggro; kill_first still names 11484 for the boss fight.

legs.name: tendris_warpwood
notes: Crystal 177259 sits at 16.8 277.2 -8.5: the four Mana Remnants around it are pulls 7-12. The door 300601 (50.6 501.4 -23.3, lock 1562) leads on; the Ironbark Protectors patrol the whole courtyard (610-689 yd).

legs.name: revanchion
notes: Turtle boss 14690 at 29.8 547.1 -4.4, between Illyanna's floor and Kalendris' hall: killed before the hall's trash, which walks past him. r33 (2026-10-24) wiped 4 times on the leg walk: the move to the boss crosses the lower hall through Kalendris packs 6 (101 499/96 510/108 514) and 2 (72 549/60 549/68 562/67 538). Group 0 pulls pack 6 from (120 505), 15 yd off its nearest member and 43+ yd off packs 2/3, on the mesh; group 1 pulls pack 2 from (67 522), 15-17 yd off its nearest member and 26+ yd off packs 3/6/12 and 40+ yd off the boss, on the mesh; both stands path-check complete from the leg walk. The two packs within 20 yd of Revanchion (group 12 and the lower-floor group 1) stay in the Kalendris leg.

legs.name: illyanna_ravenoak
notes: Illyanna patrols a 266 yd loop on the upper floor; Ferra (14308) is her pet (boss.first). The room pack that stands within her detection is the last pull before the boss step.

Server-path fix 2026-10-24 round 2 (r33 slot7b, steps 152 and 157): the z -23 pit and the z 28.6 balcony have no walkable link to the hall near -64 490.7; the only route to either is the east loop and the stairs at x 125. Pull group 3 (the first z -4 pack after the pit) carries the approach 21.33 547.47 -23.22, 24.8 450.93 -22.12, 5.07 371.47 -3.02 and the stand -61.33 515 -3.52 (19.6 yd from group 4's pack, 35.7 yd from its own), and pull group 7 (the first z 28.6 pack) the approach -64 493.6 -4.32, 70.4 498.4 -3.52, 125.07 483.2 -2.32 and the stair top 124.8 539.2 28.68. The exporter's cut fills each with 50 yd hops; every exported leg passes path-check from the last executed move, and the first chain point of each is reachable from every spot the pulls before it leave the party on.

legs.name: magister_kalendris
notes: Kalendris is a Shadowform/Mind Flay caster (Dominate Mind 7645). The 3.6 pull holds Tsu'zee (11467, rank 2 rare, 17766 hp, immune 612449875): explicit, kill_first.

legs.name: immol'thar
notes: Immol'thar is level 61 and not selectable until all five crystals are used: the pulls of this leg hold crystals 4 and 5 (8 Mana Remnants) and the 18 patrolling Residual Monstrosities. His 16 Summoners turn hostile at the event; expect them as adds, not pulls.

legs.name: prince_tortheldrin
notes: Tortheldrin is enabled only after Immol'thar dies (instance script); his hall's three upper packs are pulled here (z -4.4) after the stair door 177211 (106.1 623.7 -26.3, no lock).
